title: L2: the translator hub IR (docs/TRANSLATOR_DESIGN.md, IR_UNIFICATION.md, L2_BINARY_TYPES.md)
description: One typed tree for every source language and for decompiled binaries. ir.py implements it in Python; the Rust core implements the same schema (serde). A document is a Node, usually a Module or a Unit. A lane that lowers a bytecode or binary also states stk/fl/info on nodes, entities and variables in tables at the root (docs: work/ilspy-port/l2/ILAST_TO_L2.md).

Stack.description: the kind of a value on the evaluation stack or in a register (a bytecode lane states it; absent: derive it from the type)

ConvKind.description: what a conversion does: nop .. truncate are general; the gc kinds are CIL's; box .. expr_tree are the CLR's

Eval.description: a compound assignment gives the old value (x++) or the new one (++x)

Via.description: what a compound assignment's target is: an address expression, an accessor (a getter call), a dynamic member

CallForm.description: how a call picks its callee; absent: by the symbol as written. JVM invokevirtual/invokeinterface: virtual, invokespecial: direct, invokestatic: default

RegionKind.description: what a Region is; absent: normal

EmptyKind.description: a plain Nop or a pop (a discarded value)

VarRole.description: what a variable is, in the meaning other languages share

NodeFlags.description: a node's prefix and property bits, as names (volatile .. tail: general; stack_empty .. has_context: CIL's)

EntityRef.description: an entity (an object of the lane's own type system), by its place in the root's "entities" table

Entities.description: the document's entities, each once: the lane's family, the kind of object and its canonical key. A document that has them is read with the scope that resolves the keys

InfoOnNode.description: the facts only one lane has, on a node: every key is one of InfoKeys (a reader refuses another)

cil.async_catch_offset.description: of an async method: the IL offset of the state machine's catch handler (ILSpy's AsyncDebugInfo.CatchHandlerOffset; present: the info is not the default) (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.async_debug.description: the Await nodes of an async method (ILSpy's AsyncDebugInfo), by their place in a walk of the function (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.async_return_type.description: the type an async method's task gives (ILFunction.AsyncReturnType) (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.calli_sig.description: a calli's signature (the FnPtrType of CallIndirect.FunctionPointerType); the target's own type is a native int (on: Call)

cil.class_tparams.description: the class type parameters in scope where they are not the method's own (ILFunction.GenericContext of a lambda, local function or state machine); with cil.method_tparams (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.code_size.description: the size in bytes of the IL body (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.constrained.description: the `constrained.` prefix's type of a call (on: Call)

cil.locals_sig_len.description: the length of the method's local variable signature (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.method_tparams.description: the method type parameters in scope where they are not the method's own; with cil.class_tparams (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.mono_state_machine.description: a state machine the Mono compiler made (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.move_next.description: the MoveNext method of the state machine this function was made from (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.name.description: a lambda's name where it is not its method's (ILFunction.Name) (on: Lambda)

cil.null_key.description: of a cil.string_to_int: the index of the key that is null (on: Intrinsic)

cil.reduced_method.description: the local function's reduced method (ILFunction.ReducedMethod) (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.seq_points.description: the IL offsets that are sequence point candidates (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

cil.severity.description: of an il.invalid_expression node: the severity of its message, where it is not Error (on: Unsupported)

cil.spec_range.description: the IL range [start, end) of the exception specifier of a catch handler (on: Catch)

cil.target_r.description: of a conversion to f64: the target was the CIL type R, not R8 (on: Cast)

cil.vb_state_machine.description: a state machine the legacy Visual Basic compiler made (on: MethodDecl, Lambda)

InfoOnType.description: the facts only one lane has, on a type: every key is one of InfoKeys (a reader refuses another)

cil.dynamic.description: an `object` that was annotated `dynamic` (DynamicType is the L2 type: this keeps the object origin)

cil.nullability.description: oblivious, annotated or not_annotated: C#'s `string?` beyond ClassType.nullable (Kotlin, Swift and TypeScript state it too)

cil.ref_kind.description: ref, in, out or ref_readonly, on a managed PtrType

cil.tuple_ctor.description: a ValueTuple<...> and its tuple view

InfoOnSym.description: the facts only one lane has, on a sym: every key is one of InfoKeys (a reader refuses another)

cil.capture_scope.description: the region (the entry label of a Region) a closure variable is captured in (ILVariable.CaptureScope); other lanes' closures have none yet

cil.kind_exact.description: the exact ILSpy VariableKind, where VarRole merges two (PinnedLocal vs PinnedRegionLocal, ExceptionStackSlot vs ExceptionLocal)

cil.state_machine_field.description: the field of the state machine a variable stands for (ILVariable.StateMachineField)

InfoKeys.description: the table of every Info key: what it holds, what it may sit on and whether another lane could state it too (ir.cpp's info_keys() is this table; a test keeps them equal). A key needs a row here before a producer may write it; one a second lane needs becomes a slot

The rule: a name needs a row (operands, result stack kind, flags, why it is not a general node, the lanes that use it, its test); a name without the cil. / cs. prefix is allowed only where two lanes use it; stage 14's review lists the cil.* names and any a second lane needs becomes a node

x-names.name: cil.arglist
x-names.operands: none
x-names.why: the CIL's vararg handle: no general operation names it

x-names.name: cil.ckfinite
x-names.operands: args[0]: a float
x-names.why: throws when its operand is NaN or infinite, else gives it back: no general operator

x-names.name: cil.deconstruct_result
x-names.operands: args[0]: the deconstruct call's value; imms[0]: the result's index
x-names.why: a piece of a C# deconstruction's call: tied to the Destructure's call shape

x-names.name: cil.ldtoken_member
x-names.operands: syms[0]: the member
x-names.why: a runtime handle of a field or method: reflection, no general node

x-names.name: cil.ldtoken_type
x-names.operands: targs[0]: the type
x-names.why: a runtime type handle: reflection, no general node (ClassLit is the language's `T.class`)

x-names.name: cil.makeref
x-names.operands: args[0]: an address; targs[0]: the type
x-names.why: CIL's typed reference (TypedReference): no other lane has one

x-names.name: cil.reftype
x-names.operands: args[0]: a typed reference
x-names.why: CIL's typed reference: its type handle

x-names.name: cil.refvalue
x-names.operands: args[0]: a typed reference; targs[0]: the type
x-names.why: CIL's typed reference: the address it holds

x-names.name: cil.string_to_int
x-names.operands: args[0]: a string; strs: the keys; imms: their values; targs[0]: the expected type
x-names.why: a compiler's string switch lowered to a lookup: C# only

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.binary
x-names.operands: args: the operands; imms[0]: binder flags; imms[1]: the operation; argmeta: one per operand
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site: the C# runtime binder resolves it at run time (DynamicType types the value; this is the site)

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.compound_assign
x-names.operands: args: the target, then the value; imms[0]: binder flags; imms[1]: the operation; imms[2]: the target kind (address accessor dynamic); imms[3]: the eval mode (old new); argmeta: one per operand
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.convert
x-names.operands: args[0]: the value; targs[0]: the type; imms[0]: binder flags
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.get_index
x-names.operands: args: the target, then the indices; imms[0]: binder flags; argmeta: one per operand
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.get_member
x-names.operands: args[0]: the target; strs[0]: the name; imms[0]: binder flags; argmeta
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site (Python attribute access is the general form: a Select on a dynamic target)

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.invoke
x-names.operands: args: the target, then the arguments; imms[0]: binder flags; argmeta
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.invoke_constructor
x-names.operands: args: the arguments; targs: the type, then the context; imms[0]: binder flags; argmeta
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.invoke_member
x-names.operands: args: the target, then the arguments; strs[0]: the name; targs: the type arguments; imms[0]: binder flags; argmeta
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.is_event
x-names.operands: args[0]: the target; strs[0]: the name; imms[0]: binder flags
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.logic
x-names.operands: args: the operands; imms[0]: binder flags; imms[1]: the operation; argmeta
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.set_index
x-names.operands: args: the target, the indices, then the value; imms[0]: binder flags; argmeta
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.set_member
x-names.operands: args: the target, then the value; strs[0]: the name; imms[0]: binder flags; argmeta
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: cs.dynamic.unary
x-names.operands: args[0]: the operand; imms[0]: binder flags; imms[1]: the operation; argmeta
x-names.why: a C# `dynamic` binder call site

x-names.name: debug.break
x-names.operands: none
x-names.why: a debugger break (`__debugbreak`, int3): no syntax in most languages

x-names.name: mem.copy
x-names.operands: args[0]: the destination; args[1]: the source; args[2]: the size in bytes
x-names.why: a block copy (`memcpy`, `rep movs`, CIL cpblk): a call in C and C++, nothing in Java

x-names.name: mem.fill
x-names.operands: args[0]: the address; args[1]: the byte; args[2]: the size in bytes
x-names.why: a block fill (`memset`, `rep stos`, CIL initblk): a call in C and C++, nothing in Java
